length_definition: Flexible wire-path length between rear wire exits of connector housings, or solder joints/terminal shoulders for soldered ends. Includes fan-outs, branches and transitions along that path, excludes connector bodies and contacts. Supplier must state exact datum and physical tip-to-tip length on approval drawing; do not silently interpret as cut-wire length. 300mm is a quotation/service-loop proposal, actual routed fit unqualified.
internal_finish: Flexible copper stranded wire, insulation at least80degC, ratings declared by supplier. Continuous flexible insulating common jacket preferred (PVC or documented equivalent); no two loose insulated wires as external probe cable. Nominal internal fan-out30mm each end unless individual line states otherwise; common jacket stops before crimps and latches. Supplier proposes jacket ID/OD, wire insulation OD, bend radius and temperature rating. Add labels at both ends, individual function labels on flying connectors, and retained heat-shrink at jacket transitions without stiffening latches. PET braid alone is not insulating common jacket. No rigid potting or excess adhesive on clips/connectors.
substitutions: Quote specified genuine JST/Harwin references first, with traceable sourcing. Unavailable parts may be proposed with exact manufacturer/MPN and drawings as separately identified alternatives requiring approval. No substitution by pitch/appearance alone; XH2.50mm, SH1.00mm and header2.54mm are distinct. Do not substitute low-insertion-force SXH-001T-P0.6N without approval.
orientation: Every number is an electrical cavity number per manufacturer drawing, not a left-to-right photo index. Diagrams are logical wiring, NOT physical connector face views. Supplier shall provide both mating-face and wire-entry views with key/latch, cavity1, wire colours and drawing view direction before manufacture. Never mirror cavities based on looking at the other end.
inspection: 100percent continuity and unintended-short inspection per supplied map, including CTRL5/6 wires. Check conductor resistance and report method/results; specify acceptance limits using selected wire datasheets and length. Inspect contact retention, crimp conductor/insulation support, dimensions, labels and jacket anchoring; sampled crimp pull test to applicable connector/wire specification, report method and sample count. No unagreed high-voltage test across NTC/encoder/USB electronics. No solder-tinned stranded wire under screw terminals. First-article verification and purchaser approval drawing required before any production release.
